verdict.rationale: Chargebee's API supports some bulk mechanisms—batch usage-event ingestion (chargebee-docs-19), asynchronous bulk data exports (chargebee-docs-6, chargebee-docs-28), and idempotency keys for safe repeated calls (chargebee-docs-18)—but there is no evidence of a general-purpose bulk operation endpoint for creating/updating/canceling many subscriptions, invoices, or other core objects in one call. missing for 10: bulk create/update/delete across core resources (subscriptions, invoices, customers), documented rate/throughput guidance for large-scale automation, and independent confirmation of bulk API reliability at scale.
